title: Oswald at Atsugi U-2 base

tellings.quote: because he worked at Atsugi, which is where the CIA was running the U2 spy plane program, you know. So,

plain: Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of killing President John F. Kennedy, served in the 1950s at Atsugi, a base in Japan where the CIA ran its U-2 spy plane program. A researcher named Dan Sheehan says this without naming a source. If true, it would tie Oswald to one of the CIA's most secret projects years before the killing.
